record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare HORN_DRILL (passive NONE in the catalog). The strategy is shared; the units differ in stars and base atk. Other units are not covered.
record.summary: Single-target special damage: normally a star factor (x3 / x4 / x5; x10 is the 4-star value and fallback, not reachable by the three listed units) times the caster's current atk. Each cast first rolls an 'execute' chance of 0.3 x (1 + max(0, (caster atk - target atk) / target atk)); on success the requested damage is replaced by 9999. The damage is still SPECIAL and goes through handleSpecialDamage and handleDamage (AP scaling, SPE_DEF division, protect/shield/Cover Band etc.), so 9999 is a very large requested amount, not a guaranteed kill or an instant removal.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not traced beyond the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate.

declaredRaw.base: pokemon.atk (the caster's current atk, not the class base atk)

executeChance.roll: chance(executeChance, caster): Math.random() < min(1, executeChance ^ (1 - caster.luck/100)); a probability of exactly 0 is always false; with higher luck the exponent shrinks so a probability below 1 rises toward 1
executeChance.examples: caster atk <= target atk: 0.30 before luck; caster atk = 2 x target atk: 0.60; caster atk >= 3.33 x target atk: 1 (capped by the roll)
executeChance.edgeCasesFromJSArithmetic: target atk 0 with caster atk > 0 gives Infinity and the roll is certain; both atk 0 gives NaN and the roll never succeeds; these follow from Math.max / Math.pow semantics, not from a fight

effects.scaling: requested amount = factor x current atk, or 9999 when the execute roll succeeds (decided before the damage call). In handleSpecialDamage: x (1 + AP/100) applies to 9999 as well (apBoost defaults to true); x2 if the caster has DOUBLE_DAMAGE (consumed); x1.2 if either side has STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT; the crit factor only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so it needs ABILITY_CRIT), reduced to 0 for a Rocky Helmet target and by 0.1 per Black Augurite of the target's player (floor 0)
effects.resolution: then PokemonState.handleDamage: x2 if the caster is enraged, attacker/target field and weather multipliers (read as a list), SPE_DEF division damage / (1 + 0.05 x speDef) (speDef halved, rounded, while the target has armorReduction), Poke Doll / Guts-Sturdy-Defiant-Coaching / Wonder Guard reductions, then ceil with a minimum of 1. A shield absorbs the damage first (flinch splits it half/half); HP is reduced by the residual and floored at 0, so a 9999 request only kills if the damage left after these steps exceeds shield plus HP. Blocked entirely (takenDamage 0) by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (magicBounce also queues a reflected hit unless the caster holds Protective Pads), or if the target is at 0 hp or resurrecting; a Cover Band ally adjacent to a target that would die takes the hit instead. takenDamage (shield damage included) is returned but discarded by HORN_DRILL. Requested vs applied: the 9999 or factor x atk is the request; the applied change is HP/shield actually lost after the steps above.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value (10, also the fallback) is not reachable by the three units' bare star counts (1, 2, 3). maxPP 120 and range 1 for all three. The execute chance depends on the atk values, not on stars.

record.positionalConditions: None read beyond needing a target (the unit must be in range of it to cast, since requiresTarget is true).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. The execute roll is made independently on every cast, using the current atk values at that moment.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: factor (3/4/5) x current atk, or 9999 on a successful execute roll (probability 0.3 x (1 + max(0, (casterAtk - targetAtk)/targetAtk)), luck-adjusted, capped at 1). Applied: requested x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor] [x DOUBLE_DAMAGE / strange-steam / enraged / field / weather], then SPE_DEF division, ceil, at least 1, other reductions, then shield first and HP floored at 0. The 9999 case still obeys protect, magicBounce, Cover Band and shields.
